description: Source code for NGAP common structures and methods, including private IE ID handling, JSON serialization, packing/unpacking, and class definitions.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Class representing Private IE ID with options for local or global types, including serialization and packing methods.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for Private IE fields, handling serialization and packing of id, criticality, and value.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for container items of private IEs, including serialization and packing methods.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to local and returns the local ID.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to global.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs the private_ie_id_c or template classes into bit references.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks the private_ie_id_c or template classes from bit references.
